subject: patient1
description: GRAFT v3 = v0 + DIVISIVE-NORMALIZATION block (~240 dim): saturating rate-level e/(e+half_sat) at 2 thresholds (40 dim), Carandini-Heeger DN log(e)-log(sigma+pool) at 4 pools (80 dim), context magnitude log(sigma+pool) (80 dim), DRNL gain (theta/(theta+pool))^(1-c) at 2 pools (40 dim). description: GRAFT v3b = v0 + SHRUNK DIVISIVE-NORMALIZATION block (120 dim, under small-bonus threshold): Carandini-Heeger DN log(e)-log(sigma+pool) at 4 pools (narrow-freq, wide-freq, fast-time tau=4.5, slow-time tau=60) = 80 dim, + saturating rate-level e/(e+half_sat) at 2 thresholds = 40 dim. subject: patient1
description: GRAFT v4 = v3b + SOUND-TEXTURE STATISTICS block (~95 dim, causal running): running 3rd/4th moments per band on log_e_long at tau=15 (40 dim), cross-band running correlations at offsets (1,2,4) at tau=15 (~53 dim), spectral entropy + Hoyer Gini sparsity (2 dim).
